subject: Security intake: SOC 2 Type II, DDQ, and trust portal access
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake: SOC 2 Type II, DDQ, and trust portal access

Hi Marta / James —

Great to meet the team earlier — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can move the security intake forward: 

1) SOC 2 Type II: I attached an abridged copy of our latest Type II report and a short bridge letter that outlines the coverage window and the scope (vendor-hosted inference, control categories relevant to data security and availability). Please review and let me know if you need the full report or an auditor contact.

2) DDQ/vendor questionnaire: happy to start the vendor questionnaire. I attached our standard vendor DDQ template (blank) — if you prefer, we can fill it out on a shared Doc or you can provide your questionnaire and we'll return it within 3 business days.

3) Trust portal access: we usually provision customers in our TrustPortal where we surface artifacts (reports, attestation, controls matrices). If you want portal access, confirm the list of people who need access and we'll request an invite. Typical fields we need: name, email, role, and whether they need download rights.

4) Privacy/regulatory notes: we support HIPAA and can provide a BAA; we also have a GDPR data processing addendum. If you have specific controls or data residency questions, flag them and I’ll route to our security team.

Next steps (proposed):
- You confirm who should have TrustPortal access (reply to this thread).
- We send the DDQ back completed or fill yours (target 3 business days).
- If you want the full SOC 2 report, we can start an auditor handoff (requires a short NDAs/portal agreement).

Attachments: redwood-soc2-typeii-2027-abridged.pdf (PDF), redwood-bridge-letter-2027.pdf (PDF), vendor-ddq-template.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks — I’ll be the main point here. Looping Ben on the thread to help with the portal provisioning and any procurement questions.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear asks. A few concrete items from my side: 

- SOC 2: Full report is available. Our control period for the report attached is 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30 and the attestation was issued by Baxter & Chen LLP (contact: audits@baxterchen.com). We can share the auditor contact under the portal NDA.

- HIPAA / BAA: We do support HIPAA-covered processing. I’ve attached our standard BAA template for your legal team to review; Connor will coordinate if you need any edits.

- DDQ: I can take the Solstice questionnaire and return it filled; as discussed, you can also accept our vendor-ddq-template.xlsx if that's faster. I'll aim to return a completed questionnaire by end of day Friday (3 business days).

- TrustPortal invite: I submitted a provisioning request to our TrustPortal team. You should receive an invite from no-reply@securedocs.com shortly. If you don't see it, check spam and let me know the preferred delivery address.

Attachments included from Redwood: redwood-full-soc2-typeii-2027.pdf (full report, access-controlled), redwood-BAA-template-2027.docx (DOCX)

I'll loop Rishi on any escalations around contractual changes. Connor — if Solstice prefers download rights disabled for any users, flag that and we'll set permissions accordingly.
